discussion.title: Empirical ordering design approved; execution remains held
discussion.status: Approved by Antony; concrete design and independent review precede implementation or runtime
discussion.summary: Antony answered approve to design of one activation-before-window-ordering evaluation without a documented API-use violation and its finite acceptance convention. This is a named exception; one request and the other exclusions remain. The bounded no-candidate assessment survives review. Both orders succeeded with synchronous file tracing; reversing calls moved the writes, and there is no instrument-free comparison or established reduction in failure risk. A qualified recurrence in evaluation or separate ordinary acceptance rejects the repair. Unavailable required evidence prevents acceptance without automatically proving product failure; every ordinary assertion must pass. A passing bound supports only that sample. Concrete design, review and every earned integration precede implementation/runtime. No numerical bound, final candidate or guest is selected; all six causal slots remain held and cause/ownership unresolved.
